### (1/7) Defer StorageItems until classification
**Severity:** `medium`

The reader currently attaches every file as a StorageItem before deciding whether it is text, so text-file AI input can reach the image decoder. Defer that clipboard format until the binary fallback is selected.

```suggestion
        // Add StorageItems only after classifying the file as binary.
```

### (2/7) Decode file text strictly
**Severity:** `medium`

Replacement-fallback decoding makes a valid U+FFFD indistinguishable from malformed bytes. Use strict UTF-8 decoding so valid text stays text and invalid byte sequences take the binary fallback.

```suggestion
        using var reader = new StreamReader(inputFile.OpenRead(), new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false, throwOnInvalidBytes: true), detectEncodingFromByteOrderMarks: true);
```

proposed_comments.title: Preserve temp files still referenced by the clipboard
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve temp files still referenced by the clipboard
**Severity:** `medium`

The CLI runs this one-day cleanup before reading the current clipboard or selected input. File-output actions place generated files in owned temp directories and publish their paths as file-drop items, so an unchanged clipboard can still point to a file the next CLI invocation deletes. Protect paths referenced by the clipboard, selected input, and selected output before deleting old owned files, and cover the age threshold with a regression test.

confidence.rationale: The new cleanup call, file-output creation, clipboard publication, and age-based deletion are traced in the exact source; the threshold-specific clipboard scenario was not run end-to-end.

proposed_comments.title: Allow HTML-only clipboard input for text-compatible actions
proposed_comments.body:
### Allow HTML-only clipboard input for text-compatible actions
**Severity:** `medium`

The new CLI can read an HTML-only clipboard package and `GetTextOrHtmlTextAsync` can supply its text, but `PasteFormat.IsEnabled` relies on `SupportedClipboardFormats`: Markdown declares only Text and CustomTextTransformation declares Text|Image. The runtime therefore rejects HTML-only input before those text-compatible actions execute. Add Html to both existing metadata entries and cover Markdown and custom-AI HTML-only input.

confidence.rationale: The runtime format gate, metadata omissions, and existing HTML-to-text reader are explicit in the pinned source and focused candidate tests cover both actions.

proposed_comments.title: Respect OpenAI policy before sending Azure prompts to moderation
proposed_comments.body:
### Respect OpenAI policy before sending Azure prompts to moderation
**Severity:** `high`

This new CLI route reaches `CustomActionTransformService`, which calls `PromptModerationService` for Azure OpenAI when moderation is enabled. The moderation service always submits the prompt to OpenAI, while the Azure provider can be allowed under its Azure GPO when OpenAI is disabled. That sends prompt content to OpenAI despite the OpenAI policy. Check the OpenAI/online-AI policy before refreshing moderation credentials or making the request, and test Azure with moderation enabled while OpenAI is disabled.

confidence.rationale: The pinned call path and provider-specific policy distinction are explicit; no external moderation request was issued.
